text: Give me a board-ready view of airline AI portfolio sequencing.
claudePromptBoundary: Full production prompt is reconstructed from current source template and captured source packet. ai_egress_audit stores prompt hash/snapshot refs, not raw prompt text by default.
claudeResponse:
Airline Demo needs a board-ready sequencing view that funds readiness before autonomous scale — the loaded IROPS packet shows 8 AI initiatives sitting on an early-stage IROPS decisioning capability, with data freshness, model-risk tiering, and Finance-approved disruption baseline still open. That gating pattern determines the sequence, not the initiative attractiveness. My
three-wave sequencing over 18 months. Wave 1 (0-6 months) is readiness — IROPS Data Foundation, Operational Event Streaming, and AI Governance Readiness Program. These unblock everything downstream and carry the lowest board risk. VP Data Platforms owns the event-store and data certification gate; AI Governance Lead owns model-risk tiering.
No autonomous customer- or crew-impacting action ships in this wave. Wave 2 (6-12 months) is human-in-loop copilots where readiness lands first — IROPS Decision Assistant and Crew Recovery Copilot, both gated on certified crew legality and flight-status feeds. EVP Operations and VP Crew Operations are the accountable owners.
Value is measured through decision latency, override rate, and adoption, not disruption-cost claims, until Finance approves the baseline. Wave 3 (12-18 months) is the higher-autonomy bets — Passenger Reaccommodation Agent, Customer Disruption Communication Agent, Airport Turn Risk Predictor, Baggage and Maintenance prediction.
These need Wave 1 data certification and Wave 2 adoption telemetry as prerequisites, plus DOT consumer-protection control signoff from the governance packet.
